title: Run cloud migration setup for Dynamics SL migration

facts.text: Delegated administrators must get approval from licensed user with Essentials or Premium license and SUPER permissions.
Sign in to Microsoft 365 tenant and Business Central online as administrator.
Open Assisted Setup and select Set up Cloud Migration to run setup guide.
Specify SQL database connection details and integration runtime on Define SQL database connection page.
Select companies to migrate from list or switch on All Companies option.
Complete setup on SL Company Migration Configuration page and select Finish.
Cloud migration setup can be rerun to add tenants to existing integration runtime service.
Online tenant storage capacity default is 80 GB plus allowances per licensed user.
